Author.Label: Edit automations
Author._Description: Create and change automation graphs and pick connections in their nodes

Enable.Label: Enable automations
Enable._Description: Turn automation versions on and off

ConnectionsManage.Label: Manage integrations
ConnectionsManage._Description: Connect, check, disable and delete the organization's accounts in external services

SecretsManage.Label: Manage secrets
SecretsManage._Description: Create, rename, rotate and delete the organization's secrets (values are never shown)

ConnectionsUse.Label: Use connections
ConnectionsUse._Description: Let the automations this user runs call the organization's connections from Code and HTTP nodes

SecretsUse.Label: Use secrets
SecretsUse._Description: Let the automations this user runs read the organization's secrets

Integrations.Name: Integrations
Integrations.Summary: Connect external services that automations use

Integrations.Title: Integrations
Integrations.Subtitle: Accounts in external services that your automations work with.
Integrations.NotConfigured: Connections cannot be saved: the application has no encryption key configured. Ask the administrator of the application to set it up.

Empty.Title: Integrations are not set up in this application
Empty.Text: Integrations appear here when the application registers connectors.

Integrations.DeleteBlocked: Used in automations: disable it instead of deleting.

Platform.Label: Platform key
Platform.Override: A connection of your organization takes priority over the platform key.
Platform.Unavailable: The platform key is not configured.
Platform.Failed: Could not change the platform key. {reason}

Form.DisplayNameHint: How the connection is shown to your team, for example «Sales bot».
Form.Name: System name
Form.NameHint: Latin letters, digits and _; starts with a letter. Automations refer to the connection by it.
Form.StillWaiting: Still waiting for the service to answer. Nothing will be saved twice.
Form.TestFailedHint: Check the values and save again.
Form.OAuthHint: You will be sent to {connector} to allow access and then come back here.
Form.NameFormat: Use Latin letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (up to 40).
Form.NameTaken: This system name is already used by another connection of this service.
Form.VersionConflict: Someone changed this connection meanwhile. Load their version: what you typed stays in the form.
Form.Unavailable: Connections are not configured in this application.
Form.Failed: Could not save. Try again in a minute.
Form.InProgress: The first attempt is still being processed. Retry in a few seconds; nothing will be saved twice.
Form.Reloaded: The latest version is loaded. Check the form and save again.
Form.RetryChanged: The first save may have gone through with the earlier values. Close the form and edit the connection from the list.

Warnings.foreign_webhook: This bot is already used by another service. After you connect it, that service will stop receiving messages.
Warnings.polling_unknown: We cannot tell whether another service reads this bot's messages (by polling). If one does, it will stop receiving them after you connect.

Form.ConfirmRequired: Confirm that you want to connect this bot despite the warnings above.
Form.BotInUse: This bot is already reserved: it is connected here as another connection, or it belongs to another account or to the platform. Use a different bot, or ask an administrator. If you manage the existing connection, delete it first (disabling it keeps the bot reserved).

Test.Reauth: The service asks to sign in again.
Test.Error: Could not check the connection. Try again in a minute.
Test.Slow: Still waiting for the service. The check is safe to repeat.

Toast.Failed: Could not complete the action. Try again in a minute.

OAuth.denied: Access was not granted. Try again and allow access on the service page.
OAuth.state: The sign-in link expired or was opened by another user. Start the sign-in again.
OAuth.exchange: The service did not confirm the sign-in. Try again in a minute.
OAuth.unavailable: Sign-in with this service is not configured in the application.
OAuth.refused: The service signed you in, but the account cannot be used for this connector. Sign in with another account.
OAuth.name_taken: This system name is already used by another connection of this service. Choose another name and sign in again.
OAuth.version_conflict: The connection changed meanwhile. Open it again and sign in again.

Delete.Title: Delete {name}?
Delete.Text: The connection and its saved credentials will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
Delete.Nodes: Automations will no longer be able to use: {nodes}.
Delete.InUseText: Automations use this connection, so it cannot be deleted. Disable it instead: the automations stop using it until you enable it again.

auth.Text: the service did not accept the credentials
auth.Fix: Check the key or the password, or issue a new one in the service, and replace it.

network.Fix: Check the address and try again in a minute.

rate_limit.Text: the service limits requests of this account
rate_limit.Fix: Wait a few minutes and check again.

config.Fix: Check the address, the IDs and the other fields.

reauth.Text: the service asks to sign in again
reauth.Fix: Sign in again with the service.

unknown.Fix: Check the values; if it repeats, open the service’s answer below.

Secrets.Title: Secret
Secrets.Summary: Values such as API keys that Code and HTTP nodes read by name. A saved value is never shown again.
Secrets.Empty: No secrets yet. Add one, then read it in a Code or HTTP node by its name.

Form.Name: Name
Form.NameHint: Upper case Latin letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, for example API_KEY. Nodes read the secret by this name.
Form.DescriptionHint: What the secret is for and where it was issued.
Form.ValueHint: Stored encrypted. After saving it is never shown again.
Form.RotateHint: The new value replaces the current one for every node from the next run. The current value is not shown.
Form.RenameHint: Nodes that read the secret by its current name will stop finding it after a rename.
Form.NameFormat: Use upper case Latin letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (up to 64).
Form.NameTaken: A secret with this name already exists.
Form.VersionConflict: Someone changed this secret meanwhile. Its latest version is loaded: check the form and save again.
Form.Unavailable: The secret store is unavailable. Try again in a minute.
Form.Failed: Could not save. Try again in a minute.

Delete.Title: Delete {name}?
Delete.Text: Code and HTTP nodes that read {name} will fail with «unknown secret» until a secret with this name is added again — unless the application provides a secret of the same name, which they will then use. The value cannot be restored.

Toast.Created: {name} is saved. Its value will not be shown again.

Delete.Nothing: The automation and its versions are deleted; no run is pending.
Delete.Title: Delete «{name}»?

Pending.Singular: Its pending run will be cancelled ({count}).
Pending.Paucal: Its pending runs will be cancelled ({count}).
Pending.Multiple: Its pending runs will be cancelled ({count}).
Pending.Plural: Its pending runs will be cancelled ({count}).

Disable.NoPending: New events will not start it. No run is pending.
Disable.Title: Turn off «{name}»?

Editor.DesktopOnly: Editing is available on a computer
Editor.LayoutChanged: The layout was changed in another tab
Editor.NoConnection: No working connection of this service.
Editor.PendingVersion: Version v{version} is saved and waits for a review.
Editor.SavedByAgent: Version v{version} was saved by an agent and is not enabled
Editor.DiscardText: Another version opens in the editor; the changes you have not saved are lost.

Errors.Conflict: The state changed meanwhile. Look at it again.
Errors.ConnectionUnavailable: A connection the automation uses is unavailable. Check it on the integrations page.
Errors.Forbidden: You do not have the right to do this.
Errors.Generic: Could not {action}. Try again in a minute.
Errors.HumanRequired: Only a person enables an automation, from their own session.
Errors.InvalidInput: The data is not valid. Check the fields.
Errors.LimitExceeded: A limit is exceeded. Make the request smaller.
Errors.NotFound: The automation is not found: it was deleted or belongs to another organization.
Errors.Offline: No connection. Check the network and retry.
Errors.SignIn: Your session ended. Sign in again.

List.EmptyText: An automation runs steps when an event happens, on a schedule or on request.
List.EmptyTextReader: Automations of your organization will appear here.
List.Stale: Could not refresh · data as of {time}

Review.Changed: The code changed: review it again.
Review.Invalid: The version does not pass the check now. Fix it in the editor.
Review.NoCode: This version has no code steps.
Review.NoTriggers: No triggers: the automation starts only from another automation.
Review.RunAsInitiator: the person who caused the event (or you, when there is none)
Review.RunAsOwner: you: you become the owner of the automation
Review.Title: Review before enabling: {name} v{version}
Review.Blocked: This version cannot be enabled now:

Problem.Connection: a connection it uses is unavailable: check it on the integrations page
Problem.Triggers: its triggers need a right you do not have
Problem.NodeType: it uses a step you may not use or that is no longer available
Problem.Invalid: the graph does not pass the check: open it in the editor and fix it

Runs.NotFoundText: It was deleted, or it belongs to another workspace.

Enable.NoRight: Turning automations on and off needs the right «Enable automations».
Enable.AgentNote: An agent does not turn automations on: a person does it from their own session.

State.Title: Memory between runs
State.Hint: What this automation remembers for its next runs. The «Set state» node writes it; expressions read it as state.get(key) and state.has(key).
State.InvalidJSON: The value is not valid JSON.
State.TtlHint: 20m, 2h or 7d, from 1 minute to 365 days. Empty: the key does not expire.

ReadOnly.OldVersion: An old version is open (read only)

Tasks.Title: My tasks
Tasks.Intro: Decisions automations are waiting for from you: assigned to you, your roles and groups, or passed to you.

Empty.MineHint: When an automation asks you, your role or your group to decide, the task appears here.
Empty.OverdueHint: Open tasks past their due time appear here.
Empty.Decided: You have not decided any task yet
Empty.DecidedHint: Tasks you decide stay here, with how they ended.

Closed.Expired: The due time passed: the task closed without a decision
Closed.Cancelled: The automation was stopped: the task is cancelled
Closed.Changed: The task changed while you were deciding. Here is how it stands now.
Closed.PastDeadline: The due time passed: decisions are no longer taken.

Comment.Label: Comment
Comment.Hint: Visible to the automation and the other assignees.
Comment.Missing: Write a comment: this decision needs one.

Confirm.Label: Confirm {{.Outcome}}
Confirm.Question: Decide «{{.Outcome}}»?
Confirm.Hint: The decision cannot be changed once it is recorded.

Tasks.Slow: Still waiting for the server. The decision will not be recorded twice.

Form.UnavailableHint: This task is decided with a form this application does not have. Ask the automation's owner to fix the step; until then it cannot be decided here.

Missing.Title: This task is not available
Missing.Hint: It was assigned to someone else, passed on, or you are no longer among its assignees.

Errors.Invalid: Check the decision: a required comment or field is missing or wrong.
Errors.DecideFailed: Could not record the decision. Try again in a minute.
Errors.DelegationDenied: This task cannot be passed to that person. Pick another colleague.
Errors.DelegateFailed: Could not pass the task on. Try again in a minute.
Errors.HumanRequired: Only a person decides a task, in their own session.

Offline.Text: No connection to the server. What you typed stays here.

Field.DocumentHint: Enter the decision's fields as a JSON object; they are checked against the task's form.

Tasks.Unconfirmed: Confirm the decision below: it was not sent.
Tasks.RetryChooseColleague: Choose a colleague again, then press «Pass the task».
Tasks.CopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the ID and copy it:
